schema_note: Registry of hardware shapes Kultrun has evidence about. A repository-managed manifest, deliberately not a service. Presence of a fixture is NOT support: `evidence_level` and `deployment_profile` are the only claims, and they come from acceptance runs recorded in docs/stages/.

evidence_levels.L1: contract, unit or fixture-replay evidence only
evidence_levels.L2: real host: detection and capacity proven on actual hardware
evidence_levels.L3: live inference: a real model served a real request
evidence_levels.L4: integrated acceptance: admission, lifecycle, restart, teardown

fixture_meaning: A fixture proves the current code still understands evidence captured from that machine. It does NOT prove the code works on that hardware today. See docs/TESTING_STRATEGY.md 'What a fixture does not prove'.

shapes.storage_shape: overlay root plus a 2.15 PB FUSE network mount
shapes.sanitization_note: pod container id and storage provider endpoint replaced; distribution boilerplate URLs dropped; no fingerprint input altered
shapes.profile_note: detection and normalization proven; inference not. SUPPORTED requires Stage 1.6.
shapes.acceptance_method: source tree on host (pre-dating the artifact workflow); later stages require an installed artifact
regressions_pinned: PCI enumeration overcounts accelerators in a container
an ASPEED management VGA is not an accelerator
ephemeral container mounts must not enter the host fingerprint

shapes.gap: no Apple host has been captured; no native macOS provider exists
shapes.revisit_trigger: an Apple Silicon host becomes available, or Apple support is planned commercially
shapes.note: The non-blocking macOS CI job proves packaging and hardware-independent logic on ARM64. It says nothing about Apple Silicon support and does not move this profile.

shapes.partial_coverage: tests/test_host_discovery.py TestHwlocDoesNotInventAccelerators, built from the reference host's real ASPEED management VGA
shapes.gap: no CPU-only host captured. Stage 1.1 finding 2 showed this is precisely where a phantom accelerator would hide.
shapes.revisit_trigger: any non-accelerator Linux host becomes available; capture is cheap and closes DC-02

shapes.gap: no AMD provider adapter, no host captured
shapes.revisit_trigger: AMD support is planned, or an AMD host becomes available

shapes.gap: no Level Zero provider adapter, no host captured

the plural accelerator model exists and is unit-tested, but no host with more than one ASSIGNED accelerator has been observed. The reference host had four visible and one assigned, which exercises reconciliation but not multi-device capacity or placement.
shapes.revisit_trigger: Milestone 1 Hardware Breadth Review, or when placement across devices is implemented
